title.en: Legislative Analyst's analysis of Proposition 39, Official Voter Information Guide

explanation.en: The Analyst says the measure requires the state to provide a voter identification card at no cost to voters who request one, usable as the government-issued identification for verification. The Analyst also says Proposition 39 requires the Legislature to pass additional laws and would need to clarify details not defined in the proposition, "like which forms of identification could be used", so the variety of IDs the argument describes is not established in the guide. "Easily-obtained" is a characterization the guide does not address.

description.en: Official Voter Information Guide, argument in favor of Proposition 39

sourceTitle.en: Official Voter Information Guide, November 3, 2026 General Election: arguments and rebuttals on Proposition 39

speaker.en: Official argument in favor of Proposition 39

text: Voters can use a variety of easily-obtained government IDs to vote—and this measure even guarantees every voter a FREE Voter ID if they want one.
